capabilities: Synchronize basic, cloze, and multiple-choice Markdown cards to Anki
Open Anki searches from note ID, card ID, text, or custom query links
Navigate from Anki cards back to the Obsidian source note and line
Hide card answers in reading mode for review and PDF/Word export
Publish notes one-way to Feishu and Youdao Cloud Note
disambiguation: The name suggests only search links, but the plugin also synchronizes Markdown cards to Anki, masks answers for review, and publishes notes to Feishu and Youdao Cloud Note.
extras: Sync is manual and strictly one-way (Anki edits never flow back to Obsidian). Setup and troubleshooting for Feishu and Youdao live in separate guides, and a manual-test checklist must be completed before publishing. Not reviewed by Obsidian staff; back up Anki before importing the bundled note-type package.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn Markdown notes into Anki cards or jump between Anki cards and the notes they came from.

relations.evidence: Desktop synchronization and Anki search opening require Anki Desktop and AnkiConnect, add-on code 2055492159
Version 1.2.0 no longer requires Advanced URI for newly synchronized cards
The command Sync current note to Feishu publishes the active editor content to a Feishu Docx document
Sync current note to Youdao Cloud Note creates or updates a published copy of the active Markdown note

requires.name: Anki Desktop with AnkiConnect (or AnkiDroid/AnkiMobile for links)
Feishu or Youdao Cloud Note account

summary: One-way Markdown-to-Anki sync with Anki search links, reverse navigation to source notes, in-reading-view answer masks, and Feishu/Youdao publishing.
